title: Spectroscopic analysis of the interaction mechanism between manganese(II) and microbial extracellular polymeric substances in landfill leachate treatment
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EW00109B, Paper
Jiasheng Li, Yuejin Wu, Jian Huang, Hua Zhang, Zuochen Sun, Tao Luo, Chunhua He
An in-depth study of manganese(II) and extracellular polymeric substances in landfill leachate treatment is presented. Low manganese(II) enhanced COD removal, TB-EPS exhibited stronger interactions, and altered proteins improved sludge settleability.
